events.name: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson's crossover dribble between his legs created space for a game-winning 3-pointer with 4.3 seconds left and he blew a kiss to a quiet crowd that relentlessly taunted him for three games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brunson scores 40, Knicks top Pistons 116-113 in Game 6, advance to 2nd-round series with Celtics

events.name: Denver Nuggets at LA Clippers

headlines.description: — With the Los Angeles Clippers' season on the brink, Tyronn Lue took the unusual step of checking in with several players by phone on their off day. The coach said he “took a lot of temperatures,” making sure they were mentally ready to fight for...
headlines.shortLinkText: James Harden scores 28 points and Clippers force Game 7 with a gritty 111-105 win over Nuggets

events.name: Houston Rockets at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Stephen Curry had just produced one of his fantastic flurries to get Golden State right back in the game when Fred VanVleet started the fourth quarter with a four-point play that stole the momentum right back.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fred VanVleet and the Rockets force a deciding Game 7 by beating the Warriors 115-107 in Game 6

events.name: LA Clippers at Denver Nuggets

headlines.description: — Not this time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikola Jokic, Denver Nuggets advance with 120-101 Game 7 laugher over stunned Los Angeles Clippers

events.name: Indiana Pacers at Cleveland Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Tyrese Haliburton hardly resembled the player whose peers have deemed him overrated.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tyrese Haliburton ignites closing run for Pacers, who stun Cavs 121-112 in Game 1 of East semis

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Houston Rockets

headlines.description: — Buddy Hield became an unlikely playoff hero for the Golden State Warriors, leading the team early in Game 7 against the Houston Rockets before Stephen Curry took over late.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stephen Curry and Buddy Hield lead Warriors past Rockets 103-89 in Game 7

events.name: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics

headlines.description: — The Knicks grew accustomed to facing big deficits against the Celtics this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Knicks come from 20 down, beat Celtics 108-105 in OT as Bridges' steal preserves Game 1 win

events.name: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic showed why he's a finalist for another MVP award with his historic stat line. But with Game 1 of the Western Conference semifinals at stake, the ball again found Aaron Gordon's hands.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gordon's game-winner, Jokic's 42 points, 22 rebounds lead Nuggets past Thunder in West semis Game 1

events.name: Indiana Pacers at Cleveland Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Tyrese Haliburton said he knows he's trusted to deliver in big moments.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haliburton's 3 with 1.1 seconds left gives Pacers 120-119 stunning win over Cavs and 2-0 series lead

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — Stephen Curry was already in the locker room with a bag of ice against his leg when his Golden State teammates arrived for halftime with a comfortable lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Warriors take Game 1 from cold-shooting Wolves 99-88 despite Curry's departure with hamstring strain

events.name: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics

headlines.description: — For the second straight game, the New York Knicks found themselves in a hole the Boston Celtics have rarely let teams out of this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Knicks take a 2-0 lead over the Celtics after coming from 20 down again to win 91-90

events.name: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 34 points in three quarters, and the Oklahoma City Thunder set league and team records in a 149-106 win over the Denver Nuggets on Wednesday night that tied the Western Conference semifinal series at one game apiece.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 34 as Thunder roll past Nuggets 149-106, tie West semis at 1-1

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — The Minnesota Timberwolves were stewing over their rough start in Game 1 against Golden State, a reaction coach Chris Finch was pleased to see.
headlines.shortLinkText: Timberwolves beat Curry-less Warriors 117-93 in Game 2 to even series

events.name: Cleveland Cavaliers at Indiana Pacers

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell refused to let another fourth-quarter lead slip away from the Cleveland Cavaliers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donovan Mitchell scores 43 and Cavaliers beat the Pacers 126-104 to cut series deficit to 2-1

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets

events.name: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks

headlines.shortLinkText: Celtics rout Knicks 115-93 to cut New York's lead to 2-1 in the Eastern Conference semifinals

events.name: Minnesota Timberwolves at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Even with Stephen Curry sidelined and Draymond Green in foul trouble, the Golden State Warriors were ahead by five points in the fourth quarter and felt they had every chance to grab a series lead against the Minnesota Timberwolves at home.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards, Randle lead Timberwolves past Warriors 102-97 for 2-1 lead in second-round playoff series

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets

headlines.description: — The Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Denver Nuggets at their own game Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 25 points and leads Thunder past Denver 92-87 to tie series 2-2

events.name: Minnesota Timberwolves at Golden State Warriors

headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards, Randle lead the way again as Timberwolves beat Warriors 117-110 for 3-1 playoff series lead

events.name: Indiana Pacers at Cleveland Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Indiana coach Rick Carlisle put it best in summing up his team's finishing punch in the Eastern Conference semifinals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pacers eliminate top-seeded Cavaliers 114-105, advance to the Eastern Conference Finals

events.name: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 31 as Thunder beat Nuggets 112-105 and take 3-2 lead in West semifinals

events.name: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics

headlines.description: — Before the Boston Celtics took the floor without their biggest star on a night they had to win, Joe Mazzulla implored his players to just pour everything they had into winning one game.
headlines.shortLinkText: White scores 34 to help Celtics stave off elimination with 127-102 Game 5 win over Knicks

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards approached for a handshake during Julius Randle's postgame TV interview, the duo putting a seal on another dominant series for Minnesota in these NBA playoffs.

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets

events.name: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson and the New York Knicks viewed reaching the Eastern Conference finals as just another step in a season that's not over. It's not time to celebrate.

events.name: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — The Oklahoma City Thunder grew up on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Thunder roll into West finals with 125-93 rout of Nuggets in Game 7

events.name: Minnesota Timberwolves at Oklahoma City Thunder

events.name: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks

headlines.shortLinkText: Pacers tie it on Haliburton's jumper at buzzer, then beat Knicks 138-135 in OT of East finals Game 1

headlines.description: — The Indiana Pacers are headed home, halfway to a chance to play for an elusive NBA title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pacers take 2-0 lead over Knicks as Pascal Siakam scores 39 points in 114-109 victory

events.name: New York Knicks at Indiana Pacers

headlines.description: — With the New York Knicks teetering on the brink of a third consecutive playoff loss and Jalen Brunson stuck on the bench with five fouls after three quarters, Karl-Anthony Towns took matters into his own hands.

events.name: New York Knicks at Indiana Pacers

events.name: Minnesota Timberwolves at Oklahoma City Thunder

events.name: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks
